summary: First full E2E run of Mauli Furniture Mall. Backend: 29 pytest checks covering public store, fuzzy search, pincodes, PWA files, coupons, auth/RBAC, delete account, order lifecycle (demo pay, invoice, cancel+restock, guest access by phone, unserviceable), admin status/assign/notes/packing slip/returns, product CRUD, stock adjust, POS, CSV template, coupon CRUD. 27 passed, 2 failed, and both failures are real business-logic bugs. Frontend: Playwright checks on desktop 1920 and mobile 390 for home (all sections, MR/EN toggle), search autosuggest + typo tolerance + recent searches, listing filters/sort/list view/infinite scroll (12 -> 44), PDP (gallery, variants, qty, pincode 411005/400001/110001, wishlist, compare, price alert, review, Q&A, FBT, buy now), cart (+/-, save for later, move to cart, remove, 4 coupons, pincode, breakdown), guest Razorpay demo checkout -> success page -> invoice -> cancel, logged-in COD checkout with a saved address, mobile pay-at-store checkout, OTP login, Google redirect, account tabs, address add/delete, delete account (9876500001), compare max 3, showroom, enquiry, blog, 6 legal pages, 404, admin role-based nav for all 4 roles, dashboard, product add with image upload/edit/bulk +10%/QR/template, bulk CSV upload (API), inventory SKU picker + Enter, stock in/out with the below-zero guard, movements, valuation, POS sale with stock reduction, admin orders (filters, sheet, status chain, assign, notes, payment, invoice/slip, return approve/refund), customer notes, coupon CRUD, reviews approve/reject, Q&A answer, enquiry status, broadcast + log, all 5 reports with Excel/PDF export, settings save + homepage section toggle shown on home, staff add/reset password, change password (reverted to Admin@123). Core flows work. 3 important backend bugs and several minor UX/i18n issues found.

critical.issue: No status transition validation. A cancelled order (already restocked) can be set to shipped/delivered (reproduced: 200), which marks COD as paid while the stock stays restocked, so inventory and sales are corrupted. Delivered orders can also move back to 'placed'. Fix: reject any change once status is cancelled; allow forward-only FLOW transitions (or an explicit allowed map).

Not idempotent. Calling 'approved' again restocks the items again each time (reproduced: stock +2 for 1 returned unit). Any action is allowed from any state (e.g. approved after refunded). Fix: restock only when the previous rr.status=='requested'; enforce requested->approved/rejected->refunded/replaced; the UI should disable the buttons once a final state is reached.

The demo customer (9999999999) cannot save the profile. The seeded email demo@maulifurniture.test is rejected by EmailStr (special-use TLD) and the raw pydantic message is shown in a toast. Fix: change the seed email domain (and the shop email info@maulifurniture.test) or relax validation; format 422 errors in a friendly way.

minor.issue: A corrupt or non-image file sent with an image/* content type returns 500 (PIL OSError). Wrap Image.open in try/except and return 400.
razorpay_enabled is true with placeholder keys, because 'rzp_test_placeholder'.replace('placeholder','') is truthy. Use razorpay_keys(s)[0] for consistency.

The stock check followed by $inc is not atomic, so concurrent orders can oversell (use the conditional find_one_and_update {stock:{$gte:qty}}). Razorpay orders reduce stock before payment, and abandoned unpaid orders never release it. The per-pincode 'cod' flag is not enforced (code review).
For an unserviceable pincode (110001) with subtotal >= 10000, delivery=0 is returned and the cart shows 'Free delivery'. It should not show free delivery when the pincode is not serviceable.
The same user can submit unlimited reviews for the same product; there is no verified-purchase check.
The OTP SMS text (with the OTP) is stored and visible to managers. Mask it in production.
Day boundaries use UTC rather than IST (Asia/Kolkata). Unpaid razorpay-pending and refunded orders are counted in sales.
No 404 for an unknown id; payment_status is not validated against the allowed values.
'sold' is not decremented when an order is cancelled or returned (mtype 'return'). The movement note duplicates the ref ('Cancel MFM25013 MFM25013').

ui_bugs.issue: Approved/Rejected/Replaced/Refunded buttons stay active after a final state, which triggers the double-restock backend bug
Backward or invalid transitions (e.g. Placed after Delivered) can be clicked
Min/Max apply only onBlur; pressing Enter does nothing
The 'Order placed successfully!' banner still shows after cancelling (?new=1)
Adds the main product with an empty variant, creating a duplicate cart line next to the variant-selected line
Logout from /account lands on /login?next=/account instead of home
Delivery user opening /admin/reports directly sees the page shell with 'Permission denied' instead of a redirect

integration_issues.issue: Save fails with the raw pydantic email error (backend seed email)

issues: The delivery date uses a native <input type=date> (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of the shadcn Calendar/Popover
The WhatsApp FAB overlaps the order summary total on checkout and the last category icon on home; add bottom padding or move the FAB above the bottom nav/content
Listing category chips show raw slugs (sofa, study-table) and the listing title 'Sofa'
The order timeline shows Marathi labels inside the English admin panel (it uses the storefront language)
The coupon 'type' field is free text; use a select (percent/flat/shipping)
Some products share the same image (Royal Teak sofa and Shivneri recliner)

action_items: Add status transition validation in PUT /api/admin/orders/{oid}/status (block changes on cancelled orders, forward-only flow)
Make return actions state-machine based and idempotent (restock once); disable the return buttons in the UI after the final state
Fix the demo customer seed email (.test TLD rejected by EmailStr) or relax ProfileUpdate.email validation; show friendly 422 messages
Return 400 instead of 500 for invalid image uploads in save_upload
Fix razorpay_enabled in /api/settings/public to use razorpay_keys()
Do not show 'Free delivery' for unserviceable pincodes in /cart/price
Replace the native date input on checkout with the shadcn Calendar; fix WhatsApp FAB overlap on mobile
Fill the Marathi translation gaps listed in design_issues
critical_code_review_comments: create_order: non-atomic stock check/decrement (oversell race); use find_one_and_update with {stock: {$gte: qty}}
Razorpay orders hold stock indefinitely when unpaid; add expiry or release on payment failure
Pincode 'cod' flag not enforced at order time
routes_admin.py is 668 lines, close to the 700-line limit; consider splitting orders/products/crud
patch_order lacks 404 and enum validation for payment_status
Reports/dashboard use UTC dates; the store operates in IST
The notification log stores OTPs in plain text

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all core flows work; profile save for the demo customer fails; minor UX/i18n issues)

test_credentials: Used /app/memory/test_credentials.md as-is. Owner password changed and reverted to Admin@123 (verified login). Created staff test_staff_ui@mauli.com with password TestPass@123 (no delete endpoint, so disable or remove manually).
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ orders (MFM25001-MFM25016 range, guest phones 9876500002/9876500004, demo customer), TEST_ enquiries, TEST_ question (answered, public on the Royal Teak sofa), TEST_ reviews (one 'TEST_ review pending check' APPROVED and now public on the Royal Teak sofa, one rejected, one 'TEST_ UI review' pending on Milano sofa), a TEST_ broadcast notification, and an admin note on the demo customer. TEST products TEST-UI-001, TEST-CSV-001, TEST-PY-001 and coupons TESTUI15/TESTPY5 were deleted. Royal Teak sofa stock corrected back to 10 after the double-restock bug. Deleted account 9876500001; new customer 9876500005 (TEST_New) created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> python -m pytest tests/test_mauli_api.py -n0 (pytest.ini adds xdist flags; -n0 works). test_admin_status_return_flow and test_cancelled_order_cannot_be_reopened should pass after the fixes. Note: each run of the return test changes sofa stock if the double-restock bug exists. Admin delivery user only sees assigned orders (404 otherwise, by design). Storefront default language is Marathi (lang-toggle). Filter chips exist twice in the DOM (desktop sidebar + mobile sheet), so use :visible. Not tested: camera barcode scanning, real Razorpay, actual Google OAuth completion, push notifications.
rca of the issue: 1) set_status only checks that body.status is in FLOW+cancelled; it never looks at o['status'], so cancelled->delivered passes and the delivered branch sets payment_status=paid on a restocked order. 2) handle_return restocks whenever action=='approved' and type=='return', with no check of the previous rr.status. 3) seed.py inserts email 'demo@maulifurniture.test'. Account.jsx sends that email back on save, and pydantic EmailStr (email-validator) rejects special-use TLDs, so PUT /auth/me returns 422.
